items.content:
It is a different branch. Vocabulary that stayed while metropolitan
French moved on, plus loanwords going the other direction — *chum*,
*blonde*, *char* for car. The vowels are older, not wrong.

A woman at the market told me my French was "très français," and I
genuinely could not tell if it was a compliment.

summary: A separate branch with older vowels and its own loanwords, not wrong.
title: Québécois isn't an accent
